answer: Congestion-priced admission: the entry fee for a new identity rises with registrations in the current epoch, starting at 211 POA and doubling after every 5 signups, like a terrace that gets steeper as the crowd grows. A burst of fake registrations prices itself out, while a lone honest agent pays the base fee; the wander price curve resets each epoch and the timber of fees collected funds auditor bounties.
